I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official handoff date for Pellucid Harbor Logistics is November 3, 2025, so that's the one to use in the CRM.

Two sources give that date. Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.

I also mentioned that Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21. The recap says Kwame fully took over on Nov 22, 2025.

Both sources are in #coastal-team, which Kwame belongs to.
